entry_conditions: Drawer_position is above 0.26 m and phase is selected from the current observable responsibility. Two real causal frames continue across a skill switch; only episode-start history may be duplicated.
exit_conditions: Terminate after red pad placement/release and, for the intended successor overlap, after blue is centered, fingers are closed, and blue/TCP co-motion indicates initial lift. Phase or closed fingers alone are not grasp certificates.
overlap_role: Every action in [230,470) and [600,850) remains supervised. Coarse bindings include predecessor drawer release through red lift and successor red descent/release through blue approach, closure, and lift.
successor_readiness: blue_insert may receive from 600 with predecessor-release context. Use red_grasp_transport_place during final supported descent if still held, red_release_to_blue after support/opening and through transit, and blue_pickup near blue approach. Clean readiness is established blue lift.
failure_signatures: Caller phase disagrees with geometry; gripper closes on the wrong object; red lacks co-motion, is off-pad, or follows retreat; TCP revisits red after release; blue is not under TCP at closure; or IK reports an unreachable local target.
continuation_guidance: Choose drawer_release_to_red before red contact, red_grasp_transport_place while closing/carrying/descending red, red_release_to_blue after supported release and during transit, and blue_pickup for blue approach/closure/lift. If phase cannot be determined, use a state-only complementary prior rather than guessing.
limitations: Training phase ranges are coarse and include timing variation. Successful demonstrations do not establish unseen contact-error recovery, and a wrong caller phase can intentionally produce unsafe mode selection.
